snippet.title: SAMSON | Development Diary - Missions & Jobs
snippet.description:
Samson is out April 8, 2026 for $24,99.  

Each day, Samson wakes up and has to split his focus between narrative Chapters, cash-yielding Jobs, and open world story content. In this dev diary, we detail how these Mission types complement and contrast each other.

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634520
Wishlist on Epic Games Store now: https://store.epicgames.com/p/samson-ab5af7

SAMSON is developed and published by Liquid Swords.

Let us know what you think in the comments, and don’t forget to like, subscribe, and follow along for more development diaries.
